title: Assam in the Ahom Age 1228-1826: Politico-Economic and Socio-Cultural Studies
author: Nirmal Kumar Basu
genre: Economic & Cultural History of the Ahom Kingdom
description: Rigorous doctoral research study published by Sanskrit Pustak Bhandar, Calcutta, examining six centuries of Tai-Ahom governance in Assam. It provides microscopic documentation of land revenue tenure (Paik and Khel organizations), trans-Patkai migration of Shan and Nora-Khamyang groups, coinage and metallurgical crafts, agrarian relations, religious syncretism, and manuscript production.
source: Sanskrit Pustak Bhandar, Calcutta / Internet Archive (dli.pahar.3374)
